title: Parity of the modified time bound
statement: For every natural number $n$, the parity of $n$ plus $1$ if the halting predicate for the fixed time-hierarchy code accepts the binary string associated to $n$, and plus $0$ otherwise, equals the exclusive-or of the parity of $n$ and the truth value of that predicate.
replaced:
For every natural number $n$, define $T(n)$ to be $n+1$ if the halting predicate for the
fixed machine code accepts the string obtained by removing the final bit from the binary
expansion of $n+1$, and to be $n$ otherwise. The parity of $T(n)$ equals the parity of
$n$ exclusive-or the truth value of that halting predicate.
